subject: gk
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Governor’s assent to Bills?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 200**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 200 : Provides that when a Bill passed by the State Legislature,is presented to the Governor,The Governor shall declare -
 
 
• That he assents to the bill.
 
• That he withholds the assent therefrom
 
• That he reserves the Bill for President's consideration
 
 
 
• The Governor may, as soon as possible, return the bill(other than the money bill) with a message for re-consideration by the State Legislature. But if the bill is again passed by the legislature with or without amendment, The Governor shall not withhold assent therefrom.
 
• If in the opinion of Governor, the bill if it became law would so derogate from the powers of the High Court as to endanger its constitutional position. He shall not assent to but shall reserve it for the consideration of the President.
 
• If the Governor reserves a bill for the President's consideration the enactment of the bill then depends on the assent or refusal of assent by the President.
 
• State bill reserved for President's consideration may be classified as follows:-__
 __
 
• Bills must be reserved for the President's consideration.
 
• Bills which may not specifically falls under any of the above categories, yet may be reserved by the Governor for President's consideration under Article 200.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 201- When a Bill is reserved by a Governor for the consideration of the President, the President shall declare either that he assents to the Bill or that he withholds assent therefrom:
 
 
• It regulated the assent of the President to a Bill reserved for his consideration by the Governor.
 
 
 
• Article 164 of the constitution:
 
 
• The Chief Minister shall be appointed by the Governor.
 
• The other Ministers shall be appointed by the Governor on the advice of the Chief Minister. 
 
• The Ministers shall hold office during the pleasure of the Governor.
 
 
 
• **Article 264**
 
 
• Article 264 of the Indian Constitution provides definitions for the purposes of Part XII.
 
• It defines the term "Finance Commission" as a Finance Commission constituted under article 280.
